part.title: Specifying an interval

graph.shortDescription: A graph of a line segment on the x-axis from the point -2 to the point 5. At the point -2 is an open circle. At the point 5 is a closed circle.

part.p:
What is the interval shown above?
Enter interval
$interval = ($leftPt.x,$rightPt.x]

The above answer will accept different ways to express the interval, including:
($leftPt.x,$rightPt.x]
$leftPt.x < x \le $rightPt.x
x \in ($leftPt.x,$rightPt.x]
